dimension.name: dimension
dimension.source: Reference [20], Sec. 5 uses a 10-dimensional lossy encoding; train-only PCA is the documented reproducible substitute because the encoder architecture is unavailable

n_rounds.name: n_rounds
n_rounds.source: User-specified reduced communication horizon for local and server comparison

graph_topology.name: graph_topology
graph_topology.source: Reference [20], Sec. 5.1 uses a connected Erdos-Renyi graph

eta0.name: eta0
eta0.source: Selected on the stratified MNIST training holdout search grid after the Reference [20]-derived 0.15 value diverged in the ADMM-SAGA combination

query_noise_std.name: query_noise_std
query_noise_std.source: Reference [20], Sec. 5.1 uses standard Gaussian query noise

rho.name: rho
rho.source: SPADE-DFL requires rho>0 but supplies no MNIST value; selected from the documented training-holdout grid

tau.name: tau
tau.source: Reference [13], Sec. IV main comparison uses tau=2

batch_size.name: batch_size
batch_size.source: Selected on the stratified MNIST training holdout from {1,2,4,8,12,16,20,24,31,48,64,96,128}; batch 16 retained gradual learning, finite loss/stationarity improvement, and a lower query budget; the references do not give a SPADE mini-batch value

vr_mode.name: vr_mode
vr_mode.source: SPADE-DFL Sec. X-A practical SAGA-type memory without per-round full refresh

initialization.name: initialization
initialization.source: Common public zero initialization selected on the MNIST training holdout and applied to every method; SPADE-DFL Algorithm 1 permits common initial client states

pathological_minor_fraction.name: pathological_minor_fraction
pathological_minor_fraction.source: Binary mixed-label adaptation used to keep both 6/7 classes at every client

local_epochs.name: local_epochs
local_epochs.source: Smallest FedAvg local-epoch setting for the common 50-round comparison

privacy.name: privacy
privacy.source: Author revision on 2026-07-17: the single SPADE-DFL experiment is non-private; DP remains only in DP-SGD and DP-FedAvg baselines
